data.name: Refs_Example_slime_Description
data.value: 16×16 green slime character. Dark green 1px outline, top-left light, a 4-shade green ramp shifting toward yellow with a top-left highlight and bottom-right shadow, and big 2×2 eyes so it reads at small size.

data.name: Refs_Example_sword_Description
data.value: 16×16 diagonal sword item icon. Indigo 1px outline, top-left light giving a 3-shade blade (white left edge, blue-grey right edge), a gold guard, brown grip and red pommel to separate materials.

data.name: Refs_Example_hero_Description
data.value: 32×32 front-facing chibi character. Head larger than half the height, dark purple 1px outline, top-left light with 3-shade hair, skin and clothing ramps, and a symmetric silhouette with highlights only on the left.

data.name: Refs_Example_slime_bounce_Description
data.value: 4-frame 16×16 slime jump animation at 120 ms per frame: rest, squash, stretch in the air, land. Only the shape changes; outline, shading and eye placement follow the still sprite.

data.name: Refs_Example_grass_Description
data.value: 16×16 grass-topped dirt ground tile. A 3-shade green grass top, a jagged dark border, then 3-shade brown dirt with scattered pebble specks; the left and right edges match so it repeats horizontally without seams.
